notes: Credit only, no start or finish, on purpose (chk-maps run 73): a small training yard (about 2400 by 2600 units) of block lanes, light-switch pads and grenade/scout dispensers. Its teleports are four floor pits back to tele..tele4 beside the spawn, a sky-sized catch-all back to tele, and a trikz pad to a deathroom; no trigger, door or text marks an end. A finish guessed from the yard would time a route the map does not have. The map's own info_players are the spawn. Not published.
